Q: Failed to load sound using Arcade Library in Python (No decoders available for this file type) A:

mp3 files are not supported on MacOS.

Q: Braille unicode cell indexes to text with python-louis A:

I think the tricky part here is that dotsIO doesn't make backTranslate() interpret the characters 2, 3, -, 1... as a dot-pattern string. It changes the representation of the Braille input/output, but the input still has to be supplied in liblouis's expected dot-pattern form. So 23-13456 is being read as ordinary characters in your example, which explains the strange result.

I ended up using an online braille translator as a quick sanity check when testing Unicode/dot-pattern conversions, but for the actual liblouis call I think the Unicode conversion you're doing is probably the intended route. I also attached the chart below:

Chart

Q: Rsync a video stream continously and watch it A:

I used a similar solution for streaming a web radio, while continuously downloading new data from my VPS every 10 seconds which avoids streaming interruption on unstable Internet connections:
while true; do rsync -P --inplace vps:~/Downloads/natio_aac_128k /home/bapt/Music/; sleep 10; done

It works fine when playing the file with VLC.

You may not not need the --append option (neither -avz):
https://unix.stackexchange.com/questions/203018/interrupting-rsync-with-ctrl-c-should-i-use-partial-or-append

Here are answers that helped me:
Rsync without creating hidden file in destination
https://superuser.com/questions/988185/how-to-avoid-being-asked-enter-passphrase-for-key-when-im-doing-ssh-operation/990447#990447

On the VPS, I download the file like this to keep the previous recording and ask confirmation before erasing the previous old recording:
mv ~/Downloads/natio_aac_128k ~/Downloads/natio_aac_128k_tmp; mv ~/Downloads/natio_aac_128k_tmp ~/Downloads/natio_aac_128k_old; wget https://icecast.skyrock.net/s/natio_aac_128k -O ~/Downloads/natio_aac_128k

Or like like this depending on the streaming file:
streamlink https://europe2.lmn.fm/europe2-live/playlist.m3u8?aw_0_1st.playerid=lagardereappEurope2 best -o ~/Downloads/europe2

Q: Python, ValueError: The truth value of an array with more than one element is ambiguous. Use a.any() or a.all() A:

What do you mean by t == 0? t is a numpy array (you define it as a linspace). If you mean one value from the array, then you need to iterate over it or use apply method

y = np.array([myfunc(x) for x in t])

Q: Routing OpenAI API requests from an Android app thorough a backend server A:

A custom backend is actually a great decision. Since your app is likely to have end users who know nothing about the Open api costs you are handing to them so you might want to rate limit them. Secondly with a custom backend you dont get to bake most details about the model inside the app for dist.

Q: mysql.connector.errors.ProgrammingError: 1045 (28000): Access denied for user 'root'@'localhost' (using password: YES) A:

The answer from @damp11113 I believe is now outdated. This error message is generated because the user you are attempting to connect with does not have the relevant permissions to do so. (using password: YES) only means that the user attempted to provide a password during the failed login.

To give all permissions to a MySQL user, type the following into the command line:

mysql -u YourUserName -p

-p means you will be providing a password. If logging in without a password, do not include -p. The command line will now prompt you for your password. Then:

GRANT ALL ON YourDatabaseName.* TO 'YourUserName';

And save the changes:

COMMIT;

See also the relevant documentation.
